description: Batch-crops images from a folder and saves cropped outputs to a separate directory.
notes: The publisher uses an opaque Download Monitor file ID instead of a versioned URL. This manifest points to the official file ID currently linked from the product page; if the publisher changes that ID for a later release, url/autoupdate must be updated manually. SHA-256 is not published and is not pinned.
The publisher specifies Creative Commons BY-NC-ND 3.0; the application's settings file BIC.ini is persisted.
